tools.name: mymc_do
tools.description: Queue Minecraft actions, get a task ID on acceptance and check the terminal minecraft.task event for completion or obstruction. Submit known steps together. Queued work continues in the background. Link a timed permission command and its movement with needs in one group. Flight waits up to 2 seconds for the server to confirm permission after sending the command. Default submission waits for combat and replaces pending tasks. Use queue:"now" for immediate food or escape. Start with eat, flee or surface to take control during low-health combat. Environmental rescue still has priority. Use queue:"append" to add work, or queue:"afterCheckpoint" for a safe detour that resumes the original task. Container and transaction groups finish their operation first. A blocked task leaves later tasks queued. A single plain chat or vanilla /msg, /tell, /w to a named player with default queue and no needs/expect sends immediately while movement continues. Send independent replies separately from a long goto. Other commands and chat inside multi-step groups retain queue order.

steps.description:
steps 必须是实际 JSON 数组 [{"skill":...},...]，不要 stringify 成字符串。一步一个对象,skill 写技能名。* = 该字段适用的形态必填;? = 可选或条件参数。
复杂形态、执行条件和完整示例用 mymc_help {"skill":"技能名"} 查询。
cross_fire(at?,mode?,maxDamage?,reserveHealth?,dryRun?)
follow_route(waypoints*,avoid?,avoidBlocks?,radius?,timeoutMs?,dimension?,dryRun?)
control(keys*,durationMs?,mode?,orientation?,yawDeg?,pitchDeg?)
look(at*)
goto(at*,dimension?,exact?,walkOnly?,dryRun?)
transit(at*)
swim(at*,dimension?,reserveOxygen?,maxDurationMs?,dryRun?)
goto_player(name*)
follow(name*)
find(target*,direction?,distance?,until?)
flee(distance?)
surface()
flight(at*,land?,dryRun?)
land()
cleanup(dryRun?)
collect(block*,count?,buried?,mature?,tool?) — 世界方块用 collect，block 填方块注册名；count 统计采集的方块。地面掉落物用 pickup。
harvest(block*,at*,replant?,tool?)
fish(at?)
tunnel(at*,spiral?,dryRun?,tool?,until?)
build(blueprint?,stopAfter?,rebindFrom?,confirm?,skipConflicts?,shape?,on?,anchors?,material*,temporary?,at?,fill?,dryRun?) — 材料放置：material+anchors（坐标数组）或 material+on（参照格/面）；单格可用 material+at，不能再给 anchors/on/shape。蓝图施工：blueprint+at，at 是蓝图原点。
excavate(shape*,anchors*,fill?,dryRun?,tool?)
probe(shape*,anchors*,fill?,slice?,where?) — 定位目标用 shape+anchors+where；空间切片用 shape:"box"+anchors+slice（x/y/z），不带 where，fill 省略或 solid。不要把两种观察混在同一步。
observe(mode*,sites?,bounds?,cursor?,format?,rays?)
use(item?,at?,target?,entityId?,index?,times?,open?,text?,back?,face?)
ride(target?,entityId?,to?,off?,recover?)
lead(target?,to?,tolerance?,tie?,keep?,off?)
craft(item?,grid?,count?)
smelt(input*,count?,fuel*,at?)
brew(input*,bottle*,count?,fuel*,at?)
enchant(at*,item*,pick?,index?)
book(pages*,windowSlot?,title?) — 游戏里的书与笔；pages 为完整书页，填 title 才署名。
anvil(op*,item*,with?,name?,pick?,withPick?,at?)
grindstone(item*,with?,pick?,withPick?,at?)
eat(item*)
attack(target*,entityId?,weapon?,mode?)
equip(item?,pick?,hand?)
pickup(item?) — 地面掉落物用 pickup；item 可填物品注册名，省略则就近拾取。按入包增量验收。
toss(item*,count?,at?,pick?,target?)
stow(item*,count?,pick?,at?,into?)
compact()
organize(target?,includeHotbar?,sort?,dryRun?,rules?,at?,into?)
take(item?,count?,at?,from?,all?,pick?)
server_travel(command*,at*,within?,dimension?) — 用已知传送落点作 at，地标、按钮或入口设施可在旁边；已在范围内时命令未发送。查询、加入、启动等非传送命令用 chat.text。
chat(text*)
gesture(name*,motion*)
menu_click(slot?,name?,button?)
menu_close()
swap_hands()
坐标写成 [x,y,z];at 是一个坐标,anchors 是一串坐标。
每个分量是绝对数字,或 "~"/"~-3" 相对写法——原点是**这一步开始执行那一刻**我脚下那一格,
所以 goto 之后接 "~" 指的是那个 goto 的落点。没有前后左右的写法。
回执一律报解析后的绝对坐标。
方块/物品/实体一律用英文 id(oak_log、cobblestone、skeleton);target 也收玩家名。
类别名有两套:target/block/material 认 log、planks、ore、wool 这样的裸名(它们本身不是物品 id),把所有同类算进去;
until 名单认带井号的 #ores/#logs/#leaves/#chests/#liquids/#beds。
**写一个真实物品 id 就只认它自己**:obsidian 不会拿哭泣的黑曜石顶,torch 不是灵魂火把,
chest 不是末影箱,dirt 不是土径 —— 要"随便哪种木板"就写裸类别名 planks。
count 一律 1-64;distance:flee 1-128,find 1-1024(不给 direction 时站着扫,最远 48)。
"needs" 声明这一步依赖哪些更早的步(序号 1 起);"needs":[] = 独立步。缺省见字段说明。
容器窗口在每单结束时关闭；from/into:"open" 的搬运和开窗步骤须在同一次 mymc_do.steps 中，不能跨单沿用窗口。
每一步都会核验:判据由执行器按 (skill, 参数) 推,达成与落空都写进回执
(「该步按『背包内原木 ≥5』核验:达成(实测 7)」)。

at.description: 用于 cross_fire / look(要面向的目标格，支持相对坐标和已登记路标。) / goto(只写 [x,z] = 到附近可达落脚点(不强制爬屋顶);指定楼层请给 [x,y,z];给字符串 = mymc_map 路标名) / transit(当前维度里的一格传送门方块;给字符串 = 当前维度的 mymc_map 路标名) / swim / flight / harvest / fish / tunnel(通道终点) / build(蓝图施工时是原点；无 blueprint 的单格材料放置可作 anchors:[at] 别名，不与 anchors/on/shape 同用) / use(世界里要点击的方块绝对坐标，点击已有方块不要求背包有同名物品；face 指它的表面；放置目标用 build.anchors；与 target 二选一) / smelt(指定用哪一座炉子) / brew(指定用哪一座酿造台) / enchant / anvil(指定用哪一座铁砧;不写用最近的) / grindstone(指定用哪一座砂轮;不写用最近的) / toss(朝那一格扔；不写优先选已测较开阔方向，没有已测空隙则按当前朝向丢弃并报告未知) / stow(只存进指定箱子;与 into:open 二选一) / organize(rules 的 stow 只存指定箱子；与 into 互斥) / take(点名哪一格容器) / server_travel

mode.description: 用于 cross_fire / control / observe / attack(不写 = auto)

dryRun.description: 用于 cross_fire / follow_route / goto / swim / flight(只试算当前已加载路线；回报预计毫秒、速度来源和当前许可) / cleanup / tunnel(试算施工材料。水平和斜向通道同时检查预定脚格的支撑、液体和未知格，有缺口时报告背包垫材。) / build / excavate / organize(只读计划，不点击、不存放或丢弃)

dimension.description: 用于 follow_route(当前维度前置条件，不符不移动) / goto(可选的当前维度前置条件(overworld/the_nether/the_end)) / swim(当前维度前置条件，不符不移动) / server_travel(可选的落点维度(overworld/the_nether/the_end)；与 goto 的当前维度前置条件不同)

orientation.description: 用于 control(默认 relative 加当前角度；absolute 直接设置世界朝向：0 北、90 西、±180 南、-90 东。未指定的轴保持原角度。)

yawDeg.description: 用于 control(单位度；默认相对左转，orientation:absolute 时为绝对世界朝向)

pitchDeg.description: 用于 control(单位度；正数抬头，遵循 orientation；absolute 时 0 平视)

exact.description: 用于 goto(完整 [x,y,z] 的精确落脚格；缺省允许邻格到达)

walkOnly.description: 用于 goto(只沿现有通路走，不挖掘或垫脚；dryRun 也只试算这条走法)

name.description: 用于 goto_player / follow / anvil(rename 必写；repair/combine 可选:同时改成此名字，不写保留原名) / gesture / menu_click

target.description: 用于 find(当前连接的方块或实体英文 id，方块可用 log 等名称匹配；不支持 hostile/tree 类别，# 名单只用于 until；未命中不能证明区域安全) / use(要右键的活物名称，不是方块或背包物品；与 at 二选一。点击世界里的方块只给 at，不填 target) / ride(骑上哪种(实体英文 id:pig/boat/horse…);已骑着时可省) / lead(拴哪种(实体英文 id);已经牵着时可省) / attack / toss(可见玩家的完整名字；与at互斥) / organize(默认 inventory；open 整理当前真实储物窗口)

direction.description: 用于 find(给了就边走边找;不给就站着扫)

until.description: 用于 find(边走边找时:路上碰到这里头任何一样就停) / tunnel(挖的路上碰到这里头任何一样就停)

land.description: 用于 flight(false=抵达后悬停；省略或true=平台落地)

count.description: 用于 collect / craft(item=要新增的产物个数(按配方产量向上取整);grid=配方重复次数。不是原料数。) / smelt / brew(1-3;放几瓶(三个瓶位)) / toss / stow / take(定量取物必须显式写;不默认数量)

tool.description: 用于 collect(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久) / harvest / tunnel(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久) / excavate(只覆盖本步;不写时节约耐久)

spiral.description: 用于 tunnel(正上/正下时改挖 2×2 螺旋楼梯(上下都能走))

blueprint.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工;形状与材料都在图里)

stopAfter.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工时:做到这个 y 层就收工(0 是最低层))

rebindFrom.description: 用于 build(按蓝图施工改绑到新 at 时，给出当前绑定的绝对锚点；dryRun 可先试算新位置)

confirm.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:确认清掉冲突格后施工)

skipConflicts.description: 用于 build(retrofit 有冲突时:留着冲突格,先放能放的)

shape.description: 用于 build(不写 = 就 anchors 那些格) / excavate / probe

on.description: 用于 build(贴着 at 那一格的 face 面放;与 anchors 二选一)

anchors.description: 用于 build(不写 shape = 就这些格;与 on 二选一) / excavate(数量由 shape 定) / probe(数量由 shape 定)

temporary.description: 用于 build(只用于材料/锚点或贴面形态；本次确认的临时支撑用完后 cleanup，已有方块不接管)

fill.description: 用于 build(只对 box 有意义) / excavate / probe(只对 box 有意义)

slice.description: 用于 probe(box 空间切片；体积=(|dx|+1)(|dy|+1)(|dz|+1)≤512，不与 where 同用)

where.description: 用于 probe(定位模式：只报指定种类在范围内当前可见的坐标，不与 slice 同用；名单去重，不套用 until 的项数上限；遮挡、超距或未加载保持未知)

sites.description: 用于 observe(sites only: 1..4 absolute integer block cells [x,y,z], no default. For a slab or stair, landing.next gives the measured feet cell as an exact goto or walk-only probe. body.clear tests 0.6×1.8 clearance; it does not prove a route or placement permission.)

bounds.description: 用于 observe(voxels: bounds=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive integer block offsets ±16 from floor(feet) at the first read; default=[-1,-1,-1,1,2,1]. mymc_observe defaults to dense, queued observe defaults to visible surfaces. Dense reads return at most 512 cells as a contiguous rectangular prefix in y,z,x order (x fastest); oversize returns real partial data. Visible mode returns at most 512 non-air surfaces, checking at most 2048 nearby original-anchor cells. Text budget 24000 UTF-16 characters; verbose geometry reduces coverage. cursor replaces bounds and pins coordinates, connection, dimension and respawn scope; invalid scope is rejected, never reanchored. Each page has its own observed_at; not a snapshot. returned_regions/count, requested_bounds/count, remaining_count (outside this response), remaining_after_page, query_anchor, coordinate_system=absolute_block, next_cursor/next_safe_read describe coverage. Continuation is caller-selected, never automatic. Hidden/unloaded/omitted cells stay unknown, never air or safe. Vision through glass is separate from collision; sites body.clear tests clearance, not permission.)

cursor.description: 用于 observe(Exact next_cursor from the prior page; mutually exclusive with bounds; absolute, dimension pinned. No automatic continuation.)

format.description: 用于 observe(voxels only: dense (mymc_observe default) or visible surfaces (queued observe default); continuation retains its format.)

rays.description: 用于 observe(rays only: [relative pitch degrees,relative yaw degrees,range blocks]; [0,0] looks ahead. Each result includes its worldBearing. Default 3×5 fan at 24 blocks. Collision rays stop at glass even though vision can pass through it.)

item.description: 用于 use(从背包拿在手里使用的物品，不是被点击对象的名字。填原版英文 id 或 mymc_bag 的自定义显示名；有 at 时不写 = 腾空主手右键方块，有 target 时不写 = 用当前手持物) / craft(已知目标物品优先使用;按游戏配方表摆;与 grid 二选一) / enchant / anvil / grindstone / eat / equip(自定义物品可用 mymc_bag 中的显示名;不写 = 把指定手腾空，默认主手) / pickup(不写就近扫并避开2分钟内刚主动丢弃的已识别掉落物；明确写物品可取回) / toss / stow / take(定量取物时与 count 一起写)

entityId.description: 用于 use(可选；本连接里观察到的实体 ID，与 target 一起给，精确点该实体，不退回最近者) / ride(与target一起指定本连接实体ID；只骑这只，不退回同类最近者) / attack(可选；与 target 一起精确指定本连接观察到的实体 ID；省略时选最近同类，指定后不改选其他实体)

index.description: 用于 use / enchant(1-3;不写 = 只看报价;写了 = 按那一档下手)

times.description: 用于 use(连着右键几次;带 index 时是成交几次)

format.description: voxels only: dense (mymc_observe default) or visible surfaces (queued observe default); continuation retains its format.

bounds.description: voxels: bounds=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax], inclusive integer block offsets ±16 from floor(feet) at the first read; default=[-1,-1,-1,1,2,1]. mymc_observe defaults to dense, queued observe defaults to visible surfaces. Dense reads return at most 512 cells as a contiguous rectangular prefix in y,z,x order (x fastest); oversize returns real partial data. Visible mode returns at most 512 non-air surfaces, checking at most 2048 nearby original-anchor cells. Text budget 24000 UTF-16 characters; verbose geometry reduces coverage. cursor replaces bounds and pins coordinates, connection, dimension and respawn scope; invalid scope is rejected, never reanchored. Each page has its own observed_at; not a snapshot. returned_regions/count, requested_bounds/count, remaining_count (outside this response), remaining_after_page, query_anchor, coordinate_system=absolute_block, next_cursor/next_safe_read describe coverage. Continuation is caller-selected, never automatic. Hidden/unloaded/omitted cells stay unknown, never air or safe. Vision through glass is separate from collision; sites body.clear tests clearance, not permission.

cursor.description: Exact next_cursor from the prior page; mutually exclusive with bounds; absolute, dimension pinned. No automatic continuation.

sites.description: sites only: 1..4 absolute integer block cells [x,y,z], no default. For a slab or stair, landing.next gives the measured feet cell as an exact goto or walk-only probe. body.clear tests 0.6×1.8 clearance; it does not prove a route or placement permission.

rays.description: rays only: [relative pitch degrees,relative yaw degrees,range blocks]; [0,0] looks ahead. Each result includes its worldBearing. Default 3×5 fan at 24 blocks. Collision rays stop at glass even though vision can pass through it.

parameters.description:
干活的常驻规矩,给哪个字段就改哪个,立即生效直到下次改。不排队,不占任务号。
一个字段都不给 = 只念一遍现在生效的规矩。
scaffold  ["dirt","cobblestone"]   脚下没底时垫一格用哪些方块,顺序即优先。
                                   赶路、逃跑、tunnel 垫桥、塔的每一格、上露天的
                                   每一格都用这份。[] = 不垫
light     ["torch"]                周身黑下来插一根用哪些。[] = 不插
lightWhen "dig" | "anywhere"       什么场合黑了才插:dig 只在挖通道/挖空间的时候
                                   (默认),anywhere 赶路和采集途中也插
travel    "auto" | "dig" | "place" 赶路遇到坎:auto 按代价自选,dig 能挖就不垫,
                                   place 能垫就不挖
reserve   ["iron_pickaxe"]         这几件家伙什收着,挖东西不主动拿。
                                   收着的那把是唯一挖得出掉落的时候仍然会拿。[] = 都不收着
fight     "auto" | "armed" | "off" 怪贴到跟前主动动手的条件:armed 手上有趁手的
                                   家伙才动手(默认),auto 空手也一律动手,
                                   off 不自动接敌。受击还手由 retaliate 控制。
                                   这一格重启之后回 armed，重连不重置；显式攻击任务不受此项控制
jump      "off" | "gap" | "native" 寻路跨空模式，默认 gap。native 的更长/高低差跳跃不保证成功；不允许踩火或踩岩浆。
retaliate "default" | "on" | "off" 受击还手，独立于 fight。关闭不会关闭低血撤离或环境自救。

料不在包里的那一条就不做,不算受阻;做过的进收工回执报数。
回执列出当前生效的规矩，未修改项显示默认值；jump/retaliate 跨重启保留。

tools.name: mymc_goal
tools.description: Register and track what you are working towards in this world: up to five slots (#1..#5). Targets can be builds, gathered items, entity kills or captures, exploration, transport, farming, redstone work, survival time, or any other project. A verify condition must directly establish its milestone result. The evaluator only tests the supplied predicate; it does not check its semantic relevance. Use judgment with actual evidence for understood information, conversation and server command results. For observable position, inventory or entity conditions, use verify probes. A failed observation or a scan without a hit does not establish absence or safety. Judgment registration records the host claim; it is not independent world verification. Call with no fields to read them all back. Scoped to world, account and Agent. When dataDir is configured, intentions and historical judgments survive restarts; mechanical conditions are rechecked and no actions are replayed. Without dataDir this table is temporary. Personal memories remain in your own notes. Rejected done requests are marked failed and include the missing evidence. Every request checks current conditions. Repeated rejection does not close the host decision turn or change the goal.

layers.description: 满矩阵 layers[y][z][x],每个值是 palette 的整数索引。

reason.description: 为什么这次必须动保留料。

unload.description: 卸掉这一份(设计连缓存一起没)。

tools.description: Check what you believe against the world: hand in a list of assertions, get back only the differences. Read-only and instant: it never moves you and never touches the world, it only reads chunks that are already loaded. Use it before writing a conclusion (where something is, whether it exists, whether it worked) into your notes.

parameters.description:
一次最多 16 条断言,写成 checks 数组。回执只报差异:符合的合并一句带过。
· {"at":[x,y,z],"is":"chest"} —— 这一格该是什么。只比方块种类,朝向、连接面不算数;"is":"air" = 这格该空着。
· {"box":[[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z2]],"count":{"chest":4,"torch":">=8"}} —— 区域里各有几个。整数 = 恰好,">=N" / "<=N" = 一侧的界。
· {"box":…,"all":"oak_planks"} —— 区域里每一格都是它;{"box":…,"air":true} —— 区域里每一格都空着。
· {"box":…,"sealed":true,"from":[x,y,z]} —— 这个盒子封不封得住(from 可不填,默认从盒中心起)。水和岩浆按通路算(会灌进来),不当墙;漏口报盒内那一格。
· {"inv":{"torch":">=8","bread":1}} —— 包里现有多少。物品名精确对(torch 只数火把,不含灵魂火把);要数一整族就每样写一条。值写成 {"enchant":"efficiency"} 就改问「带这个附魔的有几件」(默认至少一件,可加 "count")。
· {"blueprint":"home-v2"} —— 这份图的工地现在对上多少格、缺哪几格。
· {"mark":"熔炉"} —— 路标登记的东西那一格还在不在。
区域断言一次最多 4096 格,sealed 最多 32768 格;超了那一条不算,会说清。
只读已加载的区块:没加载的格照实说"没加载",既不算符合也不算不符——走近了再对一次。

checks.description: 一组断言;每条一个对象,形状见上。

Read-only and instant. Without id it shows the map in your main hand, then off hand, then the first one in your bag.

tools.name: mymc_bag
tools.description: Read inventory now, or compare requirements (required = total needed, keep = amount you choose to retain) to current stock. Shows how many of the 36 slots are used, what is in them, what is in your hand, and what armour you are wearing. Read-only and instant — it never moves you, never touches the world and never touches the work queue. Set item to a material ID, Chinese material name, or exact custom display name to count current carried stock. Use detail:"storage" with item to also locate equipment, open container and historical chest records. Closed virtual backpacks are not included. Chest locations and counts are historical until reopened; they remain available when carried inventory is still syncing. Use detail:"slots" for both identifiers of each carried stack: inventorySlot for player inventory 0–35, windowSlot for the player window 9–44. Use the field required by the transfer. item optionally filters stacks; freeSlots always covers the entire carried inventory. Use detail:"changes" for the latest confirmed net change across carried slots, or item alone for a typed current carried quantity. Read game guidebooks and custom books in your synced inventory without opening them: detail:"book" lists books, then pass windowSlot and page (1-based) to read a page. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to find out what you are carrying. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

item.description: Optional focused stock lookup by material ID, Chinese material name, or exact custom display name.

detail.description: Default summary; slots reads the player window (9–44); changes returns latest net changes; storage locates an item; book lists or reads carried books.

windowSlot.description: detail:book only. Use the player window slot from the book list (45 is offhand).

page.description: detail:book with windowSlot only. One book page, first page is 1.

offset.description: For a changes continuation, copy the offset and revision from next_safe_read.

revision.description: Inventory-change revision returned with a continuation.

requirements.description: Targeted planning read, instead of item/detail. Material IDs count all stack variants. Keep amounts are your assumptions for this query.

required.description: Total input needed for this task, before subtracting stock.

keep.description: Amount of this material to leave untouched; defaults to zero.

tools.name: mymc_queue
tools.description: Read the Minecraft work queue right now: the task being executed and which step it is on, the tasks waiting behind it, and how the most recent finished task ended. Read-only and instant — it changes nothing. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to check progress. Default output includes a compact historical terminal summary; taskId reads that task’s full original receipt (latest 64 tasks in this World), or detail:"full" expands the latest receipt. Task terminal events arrive automatically; queued work continues without polling or another model turn. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

taskId.description: Optional task identity for its complete historical terminal receipt.

detail.description: Default summary; full expands the latest terminal receipt.

tools.name: mymc_blocked
tools.description: Read the last few steps that did not work out: when, which task, which step, and the verbatim reason each one reported. Read-only and instant. Ask this instead of re-submitting a task to find out why it failed. Once per turn: asking again in the same turn returns a one-line pointer to the answer above.

tools.name: mymc_stop
tools.description: Clear the Minecraft work queue: stop what is being done right now and drop everything waiting behind it. Death recovery continues on this connection; stopping the World or disconnecting cancels it.

tools.name: mymc_escape
tools.description: Cheat: teleport to the NEAREST safe anchor (your respawn bed/anchor, the world spawn, or a place you marked as 家/床 on mymc_map) keeping all items, and clear the work queue. ONLY for getting genuinely unstuck — when movement or the task truly cannot make progress. It is NOT a way to travel: do not use it to get somewhere you could walk to. Say something to the audience first. The nearest anchor may still be far from here; the receipt lists every candidate with its distance and says which one it used.

tools.name: mymc_server_info
tools.description: 读取本连接认证阶段、千灯纪职业/技能最近观测、已知玩家和官网入口。未同步或过时的字段保持未知；这是信息读取，不施放技能、不执行任务。普通游戏操作复用共享 World 的 mymc_do 等工具。

description.en: Real queued task terminal outcomes: done, partial, blocked or cancelled.

prompts.title: 千灯纪-lite 游戏环境
prompts.content:
你正在通过千灯纪-lite操作共享 Minecraft 身体；当前服务器、账号和世界事实以本连接读数为准。
只使用本扩展实际声明的14个工具：mymc_do、mymc_scout、mymc_policy、mymc_goal、mymc_map、mymc_blueprint、mymc_check、mymc_view_map、mymc_bag、mymc_queue、mymc_blocked、mymc_stop、mymc_escape、mymc_server_info。参数以各工具声明为准。
已明确的连续动作可放进一次 mymc_do 的 steps；queue:"append"续到队尾，救急短组可用queue:"now"。受理不等于完成，以原任务终态、实际落点和背包或方块净变化验收。未知结果不重放。
观察用mymc_scout，背包、队列和失败原话分别用mymc_bag、mymc_queue、mymc_blocked；证据和现场未变化时不反复查询或原样重试。权限被拒时换路线或目标，不绕过服务器保护。
密码只在操作者私密面板保存，不进入聊天、任务或模型参数。只有本连接明确的登录成功回执和当前脚下区块就绪才可行动。mymc_server_info未提供的职业、技能和玩家名单是未知，不能根据聊天猜成当前事实。
